description: CivicFlow AI 15-Domain Fixed Semantic Taxonomy with Administrative Department Mappings

SAN.name: Sanitation & Waste Management
SAN.description: Administrative department handling solid waste, street sweeping, and public sanitation

RDW.name: Roads & Public Works
RDW.description: Administrative department handling road repairs, footpaths, bridges, and civil infrastructure

ELE.name: Electricity & Street Lighting
ELE.description: Administrative department handling streetlights, electrical infrastructure, and high voltage safety

WTR.name: Water Supply & Sewage
WTR.description: Administrative department handling potable water supply, sewerage lines, and stormwater drainage

PRK.name: Parks & Environment
PRK.description: Administrative department handling urban green space, trees, parks, and environmental complaints

SOLID_WASTE.description: Complaints concerning garbage collection, waste dumping, public bins, and street sweeping

SAN-GARB.description: Scheduled garbage collection missed or trash accumulating outside households and residential areas

department_mapping.notes: Directly routed to Sanitation & Waste Management department

example_intents: Garbage vehicle has not arrived for three days
Kachra vehicle badha nahi aala
Dustbin outside society is overflowing with household trash

SAN-DUMP.description: Unauthorized dumping of commercial, industrial, or bulk waste on open plots, vacant land, or roadside

department_mapping.notes: Directly routed to Sanitation & Waste Management department

example_intents: Somebody dumped tons of waste in the open plot near market
Khulya jaga me illegal dumping ho raha hai
Truck dumping garbage illegally at midnight

SAN-BIN.description: Public community dustbins damaged, broken, missing, or overflowing creating unhygienic conditions

department_mapping.notes: Directly routed to Sanitation & Waste Management department

example_intents: Public bin is broken and trash spilled all over street
Kachra kundi tutli aahe
Community bin needs urgent replacement

SAN-SWEEP.description: Roads, alleys, or public plazas not swept, leaves and debris accumulating on streets

department_mapping.notes: Directly routed to Sanitation & Waste Management department

example_intents: Street sweeper has not cleaned main road for a week
Rasta safai zali nahi
Heavy dust and dead leaves on roadside

WATER_SUPPLY.description: Complaints concerning drinking water supply, pipeline leaks, low pressure, and water contamination

WTR-LEAK.description: Municipal supply pipeline bursts, high-volume drinking water leaks on public roads or main lines

department_mapping.notes: Directly routed to Water Supply & Sewage department

example_intents: Main water pipeline burst near bus stop, thousands of liters wasted
Paanyachi line leak aahe
Drinking water pipeline leaking heavily under main road

WTR-QUAL.description: Dirty, muddy, foul-smelling, or contaminated tap water supplied to residential or commercial areas

department_mapping.notes: Directly routed to Water Supply & Sewage department

example_intents: Tap water is coming black and smells bad
Pinyache pani ghanerdya vasache yetahe
Contaminated water coming from municipal supply

WTR-PRES.description: Inadequate water pressure or total absence of water supply during scheduled supply hours

department_mapping.notes: Directly routed to Water Supply & Sewage department

example_intents: No water supply for the past two days in block C
Pani khup kamya dabane yetahe
Water pressure is too low to fill tank

SEWERAGE_DRAINAGE.description: Complaints regarding sewage pipeline blockages, sewer overflow, open manholes, and drainage leaks

SEW-BLOCK.description: Underground sewer pipe blockage causing filthy sewage water to overflow onto streets or property

department_mapping.notes: Directly routed to Water Supply & Sewage department

example_intents: Gutter water overflowing onto main street
Gatar saaf kara, pani rastyavar aale aahe
Sewage backup leaking into residential compound

SEW-MAN.description: Manhole chamber cover missing, damaged, or broken creating severe risk of fall or accident

department_mapping.notes: Directly routed to Water Supply & Sewage department

example_intents: Manhole cover is open near dangerous curve
Gatarache dhakan ughade aahe, accident honyachi bhiti
Broken chamber cover on walk path

STORM_WATER.description: Complaints regarding rainwater flooding, waterlogging on streets, and blocked storm drains/nallahs

STM-LOG.description: Monsoon waterlogging or standing rainwater accumulation blocking traffic or pedestrians

department_mapping.notes: Directly routed to Water Supply & Sewage department

example_intents: Knee deep waterlogging under railway subway
Rastyavar pani sathle aahe
Severe rainwater stagnation outside apartment gate

STM-DRN.description: Stormwater drain, roadside gutter, or major nallah blocked with silt, plastic, or debris

department_mapping.notes: Directly routed to Water Supply & Sewage department

example_intents: Storm drain blocked with plastic bags before monsoon
Nalla saaf kela nahi
Drainage channel choked with trash causing backflow

ROADS_FOOTPATHS.description: Complaints regarding potholes, damaged asphalt, broken sidewalks, pavers, and road surface hazards

RDW-POT.description: Potholes, craters, or surface erosion on vehicle lanes and highways requiring asphalt patching

department_mapping.notes: Directly routed to Roads & Public Works department

example_intents: Huge pothole near signal damaging bikes
Rastyavar motha khadda padla aahe
Multiple dangerous potholes on flyover approach

RDW-WALK.description: Damaged footpath pavers, uneven pedestrian walkway, broken curb stones, or exposed trenches

department_mapping.notes: Directly routed to Roads & Public Works department

example_intents: Footpath tiles broken and missing, senior citizens falling
Footpath tutla aahe
Pedestrian walkway pavement completely destroyed

RDW-RD.description: Long stretches of road dug up and abandoned, uneven road surfacing, or broken road dividers

department_mapping.notes: Directly routed to Roads & Public Works department

example_intents: Road dug up for pipeline was left unpaved for months
Rasta khadun thevla aahe plaster nahi kela
Crumbling asphalt and uneven surface on main avenue

STREET_LIGHTING.description: Complaints regarding non-functioning streetlights, dark stretches, damaged light poles, and exposed wires

ELE-LGT.description: Single or multiple street lights not illuminating during night hours causing dark streets

department_mapping.notes: Directly routed to Electricity & Street Lighting department

example_intents: All streetlights on colony road are off for past week
Street light chalat nahi aahe
Dark stretch on main road due to non-functional LED lamps

ELE-POLE.description: Electrical junction box open, wires hanging dangerously, or tilted street light pole

department_mapping.notes: Directly routed to Electricity & Street Lighting department

example_intents: Live electrical wires hanging low near children park
Vidyut khamba kalala aahe, live wire ughadi aahe
Open junction box at light pole base

GARDENS_TREES.description: Complaints regarding fallen tree branches, dangerous overgrown trees, park maintenance, and lawn care

PRK-TREE.description: Overhanging dangerous branches, fallen tree blocking road/powerlines, or dead tree removal request

department_mapping.notes: Directly routed to Parks & Environment department

example_intents: Big tree branch fell across main road after storm
Zadachi phaandi tutun rastyavar padli aahe
Overgrown branch touching overhead electrical wires

PRK-MAINT.description: Public park equipment broken, unmaintained lawns, broken garden lights or boundary fences

department_mapping.notes: Directly routed to Parks & Environment department

example_intents: Children swings broken in municipal garden
Baghichi dekhbhal hot nahi
Park play equipment damaged and hazardous

PUBLIC_HEALTH.description: Complaints regarding mosquito breeding, pest control, stray animals, carcasses, and public toilets

SAN-PEST.description: Mosquito breeding in stagnant water, request for chemical fogging or vector disease prevention

department_mapping.notes: Directly routed to Sanitation & Waste Management department

example_intents: High mosquito density in colony, request anti-mosquito fogging
Machhar khup zale aahet fogging kara
Stagnant pool breeding mosquitoes near school

SAN-ANML.description: Stray dog aggression, dead animal lying on public road needing sanitary removal

department_mapping.notes: Directly routed to Sanitation & Waste Management department

example_intents: Dead dog on highway needs immediate removal
Mulela prani rastyavar padla aahe
Pack of aggressive stray dogs near market

SAN-HYG.description: Municipal public toilet filthy, clogged, dirty water accumulation, or no water supply

department_mapping.notes: Directly routed to Sanitation & Waste Management department

example_intents: Public toilet near station is completely filthy and uncleaned
Sarvajanik shauchalay ghanerde aahe
No water and dirty conditions in community restroom

BUILDING_CONSTRUCTION.description: Complaints regarding unauthorized construction, unsafe structural work, and construction debris

RDW-BLDG.description: Illegal building extension, structural modifications without permit, unsafe scaffolding

department_mapping.notes: Mapped to Roads & Public Works (Building Permission cell)

example_intents: Neighbor constructing extra floor illegally without civic permission
Anadhikrut baandhkaam suru aahe
Unsafe scaffolding over public footpath without safety nets

RDW-DEBR.description: Building debris, concrete waste, sand, or stones dumped illegally on public streets

department_mapping.notes: Directly routed to Roads & Public Works department

example_intents: Builder dumped construction debris on public lane blocking access
Baandhkaam malba rastyavar takla aahe
Debris and concrete waste left on footpath

ENCROACHMENT.description: Complaints regarding unauthorized hawker stalls, illegal structures, or commercial obstruction of footpaths/roads

RDW-ENC.description: Illegal hawkers, permanent shops expanding onto footpaths, or sheds blocking public pathways

department_mapping.notes: Routed to Roads & Public Works (Encroachment Removal cell)

example_intents: Shopkeeper erected permanent counter covering whole footpath
Footpath var anadhikrut dukane aali aahet
Hawkers completely blocking street entrance

TRAFFIC_PARKING.description: Complaints regarding illegal parking, double parking blocking lanes, broken traffic signs and bollards

RDW-TRF.description: Abandoned vehicles, illegal double parking blocking residential gates or traffic flow

department_mapping.notes: Routed to Roads & Public Works (Traffic Engineering cell)

example_intents: Abandoned scrap car blocking lane entrance for weeks
Gadi rastyavar anadhikrut pane park keli aahe
Commercial trucks illegally parked in residential zone

RDW-SIGN.description: Damaged speed bump signage, missing stop signs, broken traffic direction boards

department_mapping.notes: Routed to Roads & Public Works (Traffic Engineering cell)

example_intents: Stop sign post broken down at intersection
Traffic board phutla aahe
Missing speed limit indicator near school zone

PROPERTY_TAX.description: Complaints regarding property tax assessment errors, bill generation issues, and payment receipts

TAX-ERR.description: Property tax bill computed incorrectly, wrong area calculation, or duplicate assessment notice

department_mapping.notes: Property tax is managed by Revenue & Assessment Department outside the 5 core operational departments

example_intents: Property tax bill calculated twice the actual square footage
Ghar patti bill madhe chuk aali aahe
Incorrect penalty levied on property tax invoice

TAX-REC.description: Payment completed online but tax receipt not generated or record not updated

department_mapping.notes: Property tax is managed by Revenue & Assessment Department outside the 5 core operational departments

example_intents: Paid tax online but receipt shows payment pending
Tax pavti milali nahi online payment nantar
Tax payment status not updating in portal

LICENSES_PERMISSIONS.description: Complaints regarding trade licenses, shop permissions, advertisement hoardings, and event permits

LIC-TRD.description: Commercial shop operating without valid municipal trade license or violating permit norms

department_mapping.notes: Managed by Municipal Licensing & Health License Department outside core 5 departments

example_intents: Commercial workshop operating illegally without trade license
Bin parvangi dukan suru aahe
Unlicensed commercial business in residential basement

LIC-NOISE.description: Loudspeaker or commercial event operating beyond permitted hours or without civic authorization

department_mapping.notes: Managed by Municipal Licensing Department outside core 5 departments

example_intents: Loudspeaker playing past midnight without permission
Ratri phar mothya aavajat mic suru aahe
Event hall violating noise permission deadline

ENVIRONMENT_POLLUTION.description: Complaints regarding open garbage burning, industrial smoke, air pollution, and noise pollution

PRK-AIR.description: Open burning of trash, plastic, leaves, or heavy industrial smoke causing respiratory hazard

department_mapping.notes: Routed to Parks & Environment department (Environmental Cell)

example_intents: Sweeper burning plastic garbage in open plot creating toxic smoke
Kachra jalala jaat aahe, dhur hoto
Open burning of dry leaves creating heavy smog

PRK-NOIS.description: Heavy machinery or commercial generator operating in quiet residential zone causing noise pollution

department_mapping.notes: Routed to Parks & Environment department (Environmental Cell)

example_intents: Heavy industrial generator making unbearable noise near hospital
Aawajache pradushan khup vadhle aahe
Commercial machine noise in residential area at night

FIRE_DISASTER_SAFETY.description: Complaints regarding fire hazards, blocked emergency exits, unsafe dilapidated structures, and emergency threats

SAF-FIRE.description: Fire exit blocked, defective fire extinguishers in commercial complex, open flammable storage

department_mapping.notes: Requires cross-agency fire brigade and disaster management response outside 5 routine departments

example_intents: Commercial building emergency staircase blocked with wooden boxes
Fire exit band kele aahe
Chemical containers stored unsafely near residential area

SAF-DIS.description: Old building wall crumbling, dangerous leaning balcony, or imminent structural collapse risk

department_mapping.notes: Requires cross-agency fire brigade and disaster management response outside 5 routine departments

example_intents: Dilapidated building balcony wall cracked and about to fall on street
Juny imaratichi bhinta padnyacha dhoka aahe
Crumbling wall hanging dangerously over main thoroughfare
